violated_contract: A subprocess wrapper must preserve every runtime control descriptor required by its caller, not only stdin/stdout/stderr. A worker that has started but cannot report readiness cannot be treated as an available deployment target.
canonical_prevention: Resolve the native executable through the pinned workerd package API and exec it without the npm Node shim. A bounded real workerd HTTP readiness test exercises Miniflare control-fd 3. The 2026-09-04 isolated Cloudflare runner hung with both Wrangler CLI and TestHarness while direct internal HTTP answered 200; switching only to the package-native executable restored public readiness.
